text:
We welcome submissions from all areas of economics, both theoretical and applied. Participants will have the opportunity to present their work and receive constructive feedback from an experienced discussant, chosen from a pool of faculty members and senior PhD candidates. 
 
The agenda includes a keynote speech on “AI and Competition in Agentic Markets” by professor Giacomo Calzolari (European University Institute) and a social dinner on the first day. Lunch and coffee breaks will be provided throughout the conference. There is no participation fee. Participants are expected to cover their own travel and accommodation costs.
 
Important Dates
Submission by the 15th of September, 2026

Acceptance notification (on a rolling basis) by the 20th of September, 2026

To submit your paper, please send an email to phd.conference@def.uniroma2.it with the subject line “PhD Conference TV 2026 - Submission”. In the email, include your full name, affiliation, and attach a PDF of your paper or an extended abstract. 
 
For any inquiries, please contact us at phd.conference@def.uniroma2.it. We look forward to receiving your applications and welcoming you to Rome.
 
This Conference is funded by the MUR Excellence Grant of the Department of Economics and Finance.
